### S10-TD-001 — Test-Fixture Cascade-Fail Repair — Integration (test infra)
**Test file path**: All 14 partial-App test fixtures under `tests/integration/` (specific list TBD when story file authored)
**What to test**:
- Each affected fixture must add explicit `.add_message::<T>()` for every message type it consumes
- `cargo test -p server` MUST pass without `Messages<T>` resource panics
- No production code in `server/`, `client/`, or `shared/` is modified (test-only changes)

**Edge cases**:
- A fixture that consumes multiple message types — all must be registered
- A fixture relying on a real plugin's add_message — verify whether plugin is loaded; if not, explicit registration required
- Cascade case: adding one message type reveals a second missing type — repeat until clean

**Estimated test count**: 14 fixture files re-verified; expected ~14–28 `.add_message::<T>()` insertions
**Evidence document**: `production/qa/evidence/sprint-10-test-fixture-repair.md` — must list each fixture, message types added, before/after pass count

*Story file MISSING — final fixture enumeration depends on author of `production/epics/playable-client/story-009-test-fixture-cascade-fail-repair.md`.*

### ECO-004 — Kill and Objective Awards — Logic + Integration (CONDITIONAL)
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/economy/reward_loop_awards_test.rs` (NEW — only if pulled)
**What to test (from existing story file)**:
- EC16 / TR-ECO-006 kill gold: `apply_gold_award(killer_economy, config.kill_gold_reward)` exactly once per kill record
- Dual kill accumulation: 2 kills for same killer → exactly `2 * kill_gold_reward`
- EC17 / TR-ECO-006 objective gold: opponent objective destroyed → exactly one `objective_gold_reward` award
- EC11 self-inflicted guard: `attacker == target` → no objective gold awarded
- No duplicate objective reward (direct path + AwardGold message guard)
- Fake mana-cap reward applies once, capped at `mana_cap_max`
- Fake free-card fallback `AwardGold +1` applies once
- Interest snapshot includes all rewards before next DRAFT income
- No `EventReader` / `EventWriter` / `Events<` / `add_event` introduced (Bevy 0.18 API check)

**Edge cases (per story QA Test Cases section)**:
- Self-inflicted objective destruction
- ManaCapIncreased below cap and at cap
- Snapshot timing: rewards applied before `ResolutionComplete`

**Estimated test count**: ~6–8 integration/unit tests
**Adjacent regressions to keep green**:
- `tests/unit/objective/consequence_path_test.rs`
- `tests/unit/objective/fake_reward_test.rs`
- `tests/unit/combat/substep4_dead_removal_test.rs`
- `tests/unit/combat/objective_damage_gameover_test.rs`
- `tests/integration/combat/resolution_event_log_test.rs`
- `server/tests/economy_interest_snapshot_test.rs`

*Pull only if Sprint 10 evidence shows a concrete reward-loop gameplay issue — see sprint-10.md ECO-004 row. No broad economy tuning expansion permitted.*

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify before any QA hand-off for Sprint 10:

1. **Server starts cleanly** — no panics; `cargo test -p server` passes (S10-TD-001 gate)
2. **Client builds for WASM and native** — Trunk builds; native binary boots
3. **Lobby flow** — room create / join / class select / confirm / ready (preserves S10-POLISH-003 visual chrome and `be8b37d` UX fixes)
4. **DRAFT_INITIAL displays 9 cards** — protect `d7211f1` breakthrough; `CardPoolPlugin` + `KeywordPlugin` registration not regressed (S10-TD-002 gate)
5. **DRAFT_SHOP / DRAFT_AUCTION / settlement / post-auction DRAFT_SHOP** — visual chrome from S10-POLISH-002 visible; SAU-007 / SAU-008 behaviour preserved
6. **HUD visible during all phases** — figurines, timer bar, RESOLUTION dim render correctly (S10-POLISH-001)
7. **Result screen / GAME_OVER endpoint** — S9-RS-002 carry-over remains functional; no regression introduced by Sprint 10 chrome work
8. **Two-client friend-game route boots** — at least one host-client + one joiner-client session reaches DRAFT_INITIAL
9. **No new client-side optimistic authority** — `S2CPhaseChanged` and economy view drains remain single source

*Smoke tests verified by the developer via `/smoke-check sprint`. Reference this list when running that skill. Smoke check is NOT a substitute for `S8-QA-001-W1` manual/browser two-client GAME_OVER evidence — that condition remains carried open per S10-CARRY-001.*

## Definition of Done — This Sprint

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — via automated test result OR documented manual evidence (screenshot, video, or evidence-doc with sign-off)
- [ ] Test file exists at the specified path for all Logic and Integration stories
- [ ] Manual evidence document exists for all UI / Visual stories (S10-POLISH-001, S10-POLISH-002, S10-POLISH-003)
- [ ] For S10-PAW-001 sub-stories: existing integration test re-runs green on Sprint 10 source-of-truth commit
- [ ] For S10-TD-001: `cargo test -p server` passes without `Messages<T>` panics across all 14+ fixtures
- [ ] For S10-TD-002 / S10-TD-003 / S10-CARRY-001 / S10-N1 / S10-N2: evidence document exists at the specified path
- [ ] Smoke check passes (run `/smoke-check sprint` before QA hand-off)
- [ ] No regressions introduced in DRAFT_INITIAL display, lobby manual playability, S9-RS-001/002 result flow, SAU-007/SAU-008
- [ ] Code reviewed (via `/code-review` or documented peer review per orchestrator memory rule)
- [ ] Story file updated to `Status: Complete` (via `/story-done`) for stories that have story files
- [ ] sprint-status.yaml row reflects each Must Have story as `done` or explicitly `closed-with-conditions`
- [ ] `S8-QA-001-W1`, `QA-COND-0005`, `QA-COND-0006` retain pre-Sprint-10 disposition unless separate actual closure evidence lands inside Sprint 10 scope
- [ ] **No claim** of public release readiness, full playable-client manual QA, full game completion, broad Standard-tier accessibility completion, playtest / fun-hypothesis validation, or full asset/content production
